title: Electrochemical detection of chlorogenic acid in green coffee beans by a carbon paste electrode modified with MWCNTs and Cr-MOF
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,41314-41329
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05186J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Maryam Khayatkashani, Safaa Abdulkadhim Almansarawi, Ebrahim Honarmand, Fateme Sadat Sadeghi, Ali Ehsani, Layth S. Jasim, Masoud Salavati-Niasari
A sensitive, simple and inexpensive method is designed to measure CGA on the surface of a carbon paste electrode modified with Cr-MOF-MWCNTs. An increased electrode sensitivity and low detection limit of chlorogenic acid were achieved.
